chunks: And al-Shaykh, may Allah the Exalted support him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from Aban ibn 'Uthman, from al-Fudayl ibn Yasar, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
There is no harm in the menstruating woman and the junub reciting the Qur'an.

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection; an expression of permissibility
key_terms.ٱلْجُنُبُ: a person in the state of janabah requiring ghusl
key_terms.ٱلْقُرْآنَ: the Qur'an, whose recitation is being discussed

ai.seo_question: Can a menstruating woman or a junub recite the Qur'an?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling that there is no objection to a menstruating woman or a person in the state of janabah reciting the Qur'an. It relates to rulings of ritual purity and clarifies permissibility in the matter of Qur'an recitation.
